description: Waterfall Bridge is a highly configurable Power BI waterfall visual designed to explain how individual increases and decreases contribute to a final result. The visual helps analysts and decision-makers understand step-by-step value changes, making it ideal for variance analysis, financial bridges, and performance breakdowns. Positive and negative contributions are clearly visualized, allowing users to see how each component impacts the overall total. Key features include: custom start and end totals, breakdown analysis, Top N filtering, small multiples, positive and negative contribution steps, optional subtotals and running totals, and flexible formatting and layout controls to match report design. The visual integrates seamlessly with Power BI reports and dashboards and supports interactive analysis through standard Power BI filtering and highlighting. Licensing: Free to use in both Power BI Desktop and Power BI Service. Waterfall Bridge is suitable for financial reporting, operational analysis, and business performance reviews.
